item.title: Version 0.13.0
item.description:
0.13.0

  • A new look across the app: nudges, menu bar icons, the statistics popover, Settings and onboarding.
  • Typing in apps on the Exclusions tab no longer counts towards your dictation share.
  • The dictation app lists show each app's icon, even if the app is not installed.
  • Pause shows "Paused until" and a time, and it stays after a restart.
  • Copy and paste work in every text field.
  • Removed: the Cmd-Shift-Option-P pause shortcut. Pause lives in the menu bar and the statistics popover.
  • The buy button no longer shows a price. The price is on the checkout page.

item.title: Version 0.12.0
item.description:
0.12.0

  • "At the next pause" is now a timing option that works with any reminder style, instead of a separate style — pick it in Settings › Hinweisstil.
  • Settings › Empfindlichkeit gets clearer, card-style controls for every timing rule.
  • New Settings › Entwickler switch "Demo-Daten anzeigen": shows 30 days of sample statistics without touching your real data, useful for demos.
  • New onboarding closing page, and the TalkRemind wordmark now uses its own brand font.
  • Settings scrollbars only show while scrolling.
